subject: Technical deep-dive: Redwood infra & architecture for RavenTech
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Roy <kevin.roy@raventech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Technical deep-dive: Redwood infra & architecture for RavenTech

Hi Kevin —

Thanks again for the time on Tuesday. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive to walk through the serving architecture, network requirements, and options for Dedicated vs. Private deployment. The goal is to align on a proof-of-concept plan and any compliance/network constraints on your side.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Thu 6/20 10:00–11:00
- Tue 6/25 14:00–15:00
- Wed 6/26 09:00–10:00

Evelyn (solutions eng) will lead the demo; Laura will own logistics and follow-ups. Please pick any slot that works or share alternatives. I attached a short one-pager that outlines the topics so your infra folks can scan ahead.

Attachments: redwood-architecture-one-pager.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber | Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Kevin Roy <kevin.roy@raventech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Eng Infra <eng+infra@raventech.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2024 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical deep-dive: Redwood infra & architecture for RavenTech

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the one-pager. The team prefers Tue 6/25 14:00–15:00 PDT. I’ll get our infra leads on the invite (I cc’d our infra alias). Can you share any pre-reads or a short list of questions we should be prepared to discuss?

—Kevin
Kevin Roy | Head of Platform Engineering
RavenTech
kevin.roy@raventech.com | +1 206-555-0110

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Roy <kevin.roy@raventech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Jun 2024 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical deep-dive: Redwood infra & architecture for RavenTech

Perfect — calendared for Tue 25 Jun, 14:00 PDT. Invite sent (please accept).

Pre-reads / ask list:
- Network/firewall egress rules and proxy config (we’ll call out typical ports and CIDR ranges)
- Expected peak qps and typical sequence lengths for target flows
- Any compliance constraints (data at rest / KMS) or restricted regions

Attachments included: redwood-architecture-one-pager.pdf, raventech-network-snippet.png

Evelyn will do a short architecture walkthrough and then we’ll run a live inference demo against a small sample workload (no keys needed). If you want a runbook or a Terraform snippet for VPC peering ahead of time, say the word and we’ll drop that into the Drive link below.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcfExampleDesignDoc

See you Tuesday —
Jonas

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Roy <kevin.roy@raventech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2024 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Missed: Technical deep-dive — checking in

Kevin —

We were on for the 14:00 PDT deep-dive and the team waited on the call. I don’t see an entry from you or the RavenTech infra alias. Wanted to check if you ran into any calendar conflict or if the invite got blocked by a calendar policy.

We’re happy to:
- reschedule — propose 3 slots below;
- run a shorter 30-min focused session on network egress & KV caching; or
- do an async handoff: we can record a 20-min demo and upload to the Drive for your team to review, then follow up with a 30-min sync for Q&A.

New proposed slots (PDT):
- Thu 27 Jun 09:00–09:30
- Fri 28 Jun 11:00–11:30
- Mon 01 Jul 15:00–16:00

If none of those work, please share two times that suit your infra lead and we’ll coordinate. Laura, can you try a quick calendar poke/phone?

Thanks — we want to respect your time and ensure Evelyn’s prep is well used.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber | Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-architecture-one-pager.pdf]

From: Kevin Roy <kevin.roy@raventech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Eng Infra <eng+infra@raventech.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Jun 2024 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Missed: Technical deep-dive — checking in

Sorry about the no-show — had an incident with a critical rollout that pulled our infra lead off back-to-back pages. That should be resolved later this week. I appreciate the options; the async path sounds ideal given our current calendar pressure. Please record a 20-min demo focusing on network, auth, and a short live inference run. We’ll watch internally and then book a 30-min Q&A the week of 7/1 — Mon 7/1 15:00 PDT works for me.

If you can drop the recording and a one-line runbook (firewall ports, sample curl), that’ll let us quickly validate feasibility. Thanks — and apologies again for the disruption.

—Kevin
Kevin Roy | Head of Platform Engineering
RavenTech
